IntroFor our location in Freiburg im Breisgau, we are looking for a Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d) to strengthen our Design Engineering team.
At NexWafe, we are redefining how silicon wafers are manufactured. Our innovative epitaxial wafer technology reduces process steps, energy consumption, and CO₂ emissions, setting a new benchmark for sustainable photovoltaic production.

As a Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d), you will be at the interface between simulation, design, and manufacturing. Your mission will be to convert simulation results into robust and manufacturable designs, creating functional showerhead systems for our next-generation production tools.
Through close collaboration with process engineers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, you will contribute directly to the advancement of NexWafe's groundbreaking wafer manufacturing technology.
Join our international team and help drive the transition toward a more sustainable energy future.
Your Mission
• Initiate and evaluate solutions to optimize equipment and machinery.
• Create specifications from user requirements from stakeholders and translate them into functional designs.
• Evaluate concepts and perform engineering calculations for new equipment and installations.
• Convert simulation results into manufacturable designs, contributing to the development of functional showerhead systems.
• Support the evaluation and implementation of concepts for digital manufacturing documentation.
• Proactively manage, support, and coordinate suppliers together with Supply Chain.
• Initiate, facilitate, and manage technical specifications for parts and assemblies used in procurement activities.
• Participate in technical discussions with suppliers and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Your profile Must-Haves:
• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable engineering discipline (Bachelor's or Master's degree; Master's degree preferred).
• Minimum 3 years of full-time industrial experience in mechanical design and engineering after graduation, within semiconductor equipment, photovoltaic manufacturing, vacuum technology, process equipment, plant engineering, or metalworking industries.

Please note that internships, working student positions, academic research activities, and thesis projects are not considered equivalent to the required professional experience.
• Practical knowledge of gas distribution systems, including interconnections, component design, and nozzles/diffusers.
• Practical understanding of manufacturing processes, including machining and welding technologies and welded assemblies used in equipment manufacturing.
• Proficiency in CAD software such as Inventor, AutoCAD, or similar design tools.
• Fluent English skills (B2 level or above).
• Good communication and teamwork skills.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications
• Experience supporting equipment installation, commissioning, or supplier coordination is considered an advantage.
• Proficient user of Microsoft Office applications.

Why us?
• A diverse team: Short decision-making processes, flat hierarchies and collaboration with experts from different areas await you.
• A diverse and exciting job: A company that contributes to the commercialisation of environmentally friendly solar energy with a low carbon footprint.
• Stability with a certain degree of flexibility: A permanent position with flexible working hours.
• Attractive remuneration programme: An attractive salary, a company pension scheme and profit-sharing for employees.
• Healthy balance: Take your physical and mental health to the next level with an annual health budget and a HanseFit membership!

About usAt NexWafe, we're striving to set a new standard for the future of photovoltaic wafer production. The need for efficient, affordable and cleanly produced solar technology has never been greater – we're rising to meet that challenge.

jobs.occupation: Senior Procurement Manager (f/m/d) Food Commodities (Fachwirt/in - Einkauf/Bachelor Professional in Procurement)
jobs.description:
Do you want to make a delicious difference?Planet A Foods is for people who want to change the future of food.We are reinventing how the world produces food ingredients, replacing scarce and unsustainable raw materials with scalable, clean, and delicious alternatives. Our first product, a cocoa-free chocolate, is just the beginning. Our ambition is to build a new global champion in food ingredients.At Planet A Foods, you’ll join a bold, highly committed, international team of scientists, engineers, operators, and industry experts united by one goal: creating real, measurable planetary impact.As Senior Procurement Manager , you will be navigating the complex world of global commodity markets to fuel our rapid scale-up. You will lead and scale your portfolio, from deep-dive market analysis to high-stakes negotiations, ensuring that our production remains resilient, sustainable, and cost-effective.
You will report directly to our Head of Procurement, working in a fast-paced, high-performance environment where your strategic decisions directly impact our bottom line and our mission to decouple chocolate from deforestation.
Please note: this contract is limited to 12 months. There may be an opportunity for the role to become permanent at the end of the contract.
A Taste of What to Expect
• Lead and elevate an assigned portfolio, constantly scouting for alternative suppliers on current product optimizations and future innovations
• Drive strategic market analysis (specifically fats & oils, sunflower, and grains) to stay ahead of global trends and volatility
• Drive strategic decision-making in sourcing and investments, balancing risk with the opportunity to scale efficiently
• Partner closely with Supply Chain, R&D, and Quality Management to ensure our ingredients meet the highest standards of performance and sustainability
• Identify risks and opportunities by providing early warnings and trend forecasts
• Act as a key sparring partner for the Head of Procurement to continuously optimize our global sourcing strategy

The Perfect Recipe of Skills & Experience
• Senior Procurement Professional: With a strong and proven track record in strategic purchasing. You bring deep knowledge of commodity markets (grains, fats & oils) or a proven ability to master complex, volatile markets and a hunger to dive deep into the world of food commodities
• Analytical Excellence: You bring a strong commercial background and love turning complex market data into clear, visible format that guides strategic decisions
• Market Intuition: You understand how global markets work, from physical supply chains to the dynamics of raw material fluctuations
• Ownership & Drive: You are a proactive "doer" who doesn’t wait for instructions. You thrive in a demanding, direct environment and take full responsibility for your results
• Creative Problem Solver: You think outside the box to find creative solutions to sourcing bottlenecks or supply chain challenges
• Master Negotiator: You have proven that you can lead tough, face-to-face discussions and possess the confidence to hold your ground with international stakeholders and top-tier suppliers
• You have full professional fluency in English

A Sweet Package
• Early ownership and responsibility in a fast-moving environment
• Collaborate with a passionate international team working at the edge of what's possible
• Work in a rare food-tech startups that is scaling and operating in a 24/7 4-shift production system
• A position where you can help to challenge a trillion-dollar industry!
• A very competitive compensation and opportunity to grow
• Stuff that other startups do as well (30 days vacation, tasty lunches, snacks, drinks, vouchers, gym...)
• PLUS: Chocolate. Every. Single. Day.

About usWe produce all-natural cocoa-free innovations without compromising on taste, quality, and sustainability to preserve the Earth for our children.

We are on a constant journey of discovery and driving meaningful impact. Through collaboration and shared success, we empower our team to take bold action and make a difference. Every role is designed with purpose, where together ideas flourish, opportunities expand and boundaries are pushed. Joining our team is a step toward to protecting the planet we love.

About us

Job description

In order to support General Procurement organization, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student within General Procurement (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the ecosystem of Procurement? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the General Procurement organization department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 15 hours a week!

- Location: Taufkirchen / Ottobrunn
- Start: November 2026
- Duration: 9 months

Fully integrated in the Procurement organization, GP’s mission is to procure goods and services on behalf of the entire Group (Airbus Commercial, Airbus Defense and Space, Airbus Helicopters, Airbus Atlantique, Airbus Aerostructure), and as such to play a major role in generating value and contributing to the overall competitiveness of the company.

We employ more than 700 professionals in 12 countries around the world (Europe, North America, MEA, China, APAC & India).

We manage a spend of approximately €15 billion and work with more than 11 000 suppliers worldwide!

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 15-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Project based support to General Procurement buyers
- Welcome newcomers by introducing them to the team colleagues and the GP communication sources
- Administrative support to the Munich General Procurement Team
- Conception and planning of local team events

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Business Administration or an equivalent field of study.
- First practical experience in the field of Procurement or Supply Management is desirable.
- Advanced English is mandatory. German, French or Spanish would be of advantage but not mandatory.
- Organized, flexible & strong adaptability, dynamic & proactive, solution oriented, ability to work in a multicultural environment.

The Department of Internal Medicine II at TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our newly established Max Eder Research Group.

Our research aims to decipher the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in gastric and gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEAC). By integrating longitudinal patient samples from prospective clinical trials with cutting-edge multi-omics technologies and functional model systems, our group is committed to understanding the biological mechanisms underlying treatment resistance in upper gastrointestinal cancers and translating these discoveries into novel therapeutic strategies.

The position offers the unique opportunity to work at the interface of clinical oncology, cancer genomics, computational biology, and functional cancer research within an outstanding translational research environment.

You will investigate the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in GEAC through the integration of longitudinal multi-omics datasets from prospective clinical trial samples.

Your research will focus on computational analysis and interpretation of large-scale molecular datasets, including:

Analysis and integration of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets to characterize tumor evolution and treatment response
Inference of tissue-specific gene expression and tumor activity from plasma cell-free DNA fragmentation patterns
Development of computational approaches for the integration of genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic and immune profiling data
Multi-omics integration to reconstruct tumor evolutionary trajectories and characterize cellular plasticity during treatment
Development and implementation of bioinformatic pipelines for high-dimensional sequencing datasets
Close collaboration with clinicians, biologists, computational biologists and international collaborators
Presentation of research at international conferences and publication in high-impact scientific journals
We are seeking an ambitious computational scientist with a strong interest in translational cancer research and multi-omics data analysis.

Required qualifications

PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Sciences, Cancer Genomics or a related quantitative discipline
Strong experience in the analysis of next-generation sequencing data (e.g. transcriptomic and/or genomic datasets)
Excellent programming skills in R and/or Python
Experience working in Linux/Unix environments and using reproducible computational workflows
Ability to independently design and drive scientific projects
Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English

Preferred qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

Cell-free DNA sequencing and fragmentation analysis (highly desirable)
Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis and/or Spatial transcriptomics
Multi-omics integration
Machine learning or statistical modelling of biological datasets
Cancer genomics and tumor evolution

A postdoctoral position within a newly established and rapidly growing Max Eder Research Group funded by the German Cancer Aid
An outstanding translational research environment embedded within TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar, one of Europe’s leading academic medical centers

We offer a PhD position in the research group of Dr. Frederik Kotz-Helmer, which is embedded within the NeptunLab led by Prof. Bastian E. Rapp at the Department of Microsystems Engineering (IMTEK), University of Freiburg. NeptunLab is a highly interdisciplinary research environment focusing on the development of novel materials, manufacturing technologies, and processes for industrial applications. Research from the NeptunLab has been published in leading international journals, including Lab on a Chip, Advanced Materials, Angewandte Chemie, and Nature, and has received attention from national and international media outlets such as the BBC, The New York Times, and the Discovery Channel.
Microstructured optical fibers are key components for next-generation photonic technologies including quantum communication, high-speed data transmission, and advanced sensing. However, current manufacturing methods such as stack-and-draw strongly limit the achievable fiber geometries and prevent the realization of many theoretically predicted high-performance fiber designs.

Within this PhD project, novel silica nanocomposite materials and manufacturing technologies will be developed to overcome these limitations. The project combines the our revolutionary Glassomer technology, silica nanocomposites which can be processed like a polymer and subsequently converted to pure fused silica, with high-resolution additive manufacturing and scalable extrusion processes to directly fabricate complex microstructured glass fiber preforms. The developed materials will be converted into high-purity fused silica glass and further processed into optical fibers in collaboration with project partners. The project aims to establish a new manufacturing platform for optical fibers with unprecedented design freedom.
You will join an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of materials science, glass science, polymer chemistry, additive manufacturing, and photonics. The project offers the opportunity to contribute to next-generation optical fiber technologies with applications ranging from quantum technologies to future communication systems.
Development of novel silica nanocomposites for additive manufacturing and extrusion-based glass processing.
Investigation and characterization of nanocomposite systems and glasses, including processing behavior, structural, thermal, rheological, and optical properties.
Processing nanocomposites using advanced manufacturing technologies, including: stereolithography-based 3D printing, extrusion-based shaping
Developing strategies for modifying glass compositions (e.g., dopant integration) to tailor processing and material properties.
Collaborating with project partners on the fabrication of next-generation microstructured optical fibers.
Presenting research results at international conferences and publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals.

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Join our Overall Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) Design Team for Eurodrone and contribute your skills and enthusiasm to our dynamic Chief Engineering Organization. As such, execute overall design and steering activities to ensure a consistent RPAS design and integration across all functions and through the entire lifecycle, compliant with top level system requirements. Steer the flight chain (Ground Safety Critical Control Station, Flight Management System, Safe Flight and Landing System) as an integral part of the overall RPAS design and ensure the compliance with all overall RPAS design activities.

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

- Optimize design for the overall RPAS and ensure integration of all level 1 sub-products.
- Perform trades & candidate aircraft configurations associated to RPA and flight chain architectures & requirements.
- Coordinate the flight chain design (GSCCS, FMCS, FMAIS, SFLS), ensuring consistent safety-critical design.

- Control the RPA and flight chain technical baseline and design changes, Assessing the consequences of technical Change Requests on overall RPAS architecture and aircraft configuration, ensuring configuration maturity aligns with programme milestones and safety objectives.
- Lead the definition of the certification and qualification roadmap for in close alignment with customer and regulatory bodies.

- Secure the project schedule to achieve the program milestones, align technical directives to all design teams, ensuring end to end readiness.

If you are ready to take on this exciting challenge and make a significant impact on the future of Airbus UAV products, we encourage you to apply.

- Master of Science in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent.
- Significant Engineering experience > 8 years in related area.
- You have excellent leadership skills and profound experience in leading teams.
- Deep knowledge of Flight Dynamics, Flight Mechanics and Flight Control Laws.

- Experience in the development of DAL-A software.

Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.

European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.

The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.

The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.

Key purpose  

- Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.
- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.
- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.
- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.
- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.

Structure and reporting relationship 

The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  

Internal Communications

- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.
- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.
- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.
- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  

External Communications

- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.
- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.
- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.
- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.

Integration Communications

- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.
- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.

Social Media & Content Creation

- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.
- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.
- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.

Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.
- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.
- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.
- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.
- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.
- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.
- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.
- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.
- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.

Additional / special features of the role 

- Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.
- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.
- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.
- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.
- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.
- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration Europe

Desirable

- Must: German native or fully proficient
- Must: English level B2
- Desirable: French
- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.

jobs.description:
AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.

AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.

Create impact with passion!

For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for a

Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)

As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.

Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership

- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs
- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity
- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management
- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites

2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery

- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover
- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs
- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs
- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics
- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs
- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case

3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)

- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings
- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines
- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families
- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio

4. NPI & Industrialization

- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production
- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects
- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program
- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)
- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans
- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)
- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp
- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance
- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection

6. Financial & Resource Management

- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio
- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control
- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs
- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility
- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates

7. Transformation & Change Leadership

- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability
- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)
- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture
- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery

8. Governance, Risk & Compliance

- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements
- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs
- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigation

Your Profile

Professional Experience

- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization
- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions
- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)
- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout
- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance
- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability
- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control
- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)
- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures
- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)

Intercultural Experience

- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies
- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures
- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level
- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisite

Personal attributes

- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus
- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs
- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)
- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management
- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity
- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure
- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes
- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates
- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups
- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions
- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments
- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talent
